entries.name: Climate Change Adaptation RO-Crate Profile
entries.summary: A RO-Crate Profile defining conventions, contextual entities, and semantic terms for representing FAIR Digital Objects for Climate Change Adaptation research in FAIR2Adapt.

entries.name: Language Data Commons Comprehensive Collection Profile
entries.summary: Profile derived from Language Data Commons Comprehensive Collection: Implements the language data commons RO-Crate Metadata Profile for the top-level, objects and files.

entries.name: LDAC-DMLex Profile (DRAFT)
entries.summary: DRAFT: a Language Data Commons (LDAC) adaptation of the OASIS DMLex data model for lexicography.

entries.name: RO-Crate Machine Actionable Profile
entries.summary: This is a mini-profile for RO-Crate itself

entries.name: RO-Crate 2.0 ExperimentalMachine Actionable Profile
entries.summary: This is an experimental profile for RO-Crate 2

entries.name: RO-Crate MASP Profile
entries.summary: Profile for RO-Crate Machine Actionable Profiles and Schemas (MASP).

entries.name: RO-Crate Photo Collection Profile
entries.summary: Photograph collections kept at rest on a filesystem as nested RO-Crates: a root crate describing the collection and the people in it, a crate per sub-collection of photos, and a companion crate of face-recognition…

entries.name: RO-Crate + Schema.org Profile
entries.summary: A self-contained RO-Crate profile with the minimal RO-Crate entry constraints and embedded Schema.org schema terms.

entries.name: DEMO ONLY: Research Software Description Profile Schema
entries.summary: Schema derived from DEMO ONLY: Research Software Description Profile: A draft Crate-O Mode for describing research software source code / notebooks / workflows

entries.name: Workflow Profile
entries.summary: This is an experimental port of the RO-Crate Workflow Profile to a proposed 'RO-Crate Schema' format.

entries.name: AusTalk Vocabulary Terms
entries.summary: This is a language data ontology based on the AusTalk ontology here: https://github.com/Alveo/bigasc-metadata/edit/master/schema/austalk.owl

entries.name: CLDF Ontology
entries.summary: The CLDF Ontology is an RDF vocabulary describing the dataset types, tables and columns specified in the CLDF standard.

entries.name: DMLex (OASIS Data Model for Lexicography)
entries.summary: DMLex, the OASIS Data Model for Lexicography (v1.0, OASIS Standard), models dictionaries ("lexicographic resources"): entries, senses, definitions, examples, pronunciations and inflected forms, plus optional modules…

entries.name: Language Data Commons Schema Terms
entries.summary: This is a language data schema, in the style of the Schema.org schema.

entries.name: lemon (Lexicon Model for Ontologies)
entries.summary: Lemon: The lexicon model for ontologies is designed to allow for descriptions of lexical information regarding ontological elements and other RDF resources.

entries.name: Web Annotation Vocabulary
entries.summary: The Web Annotation ontology defines the terms of the Web Annotation vocabulary.

entries.name: Records in Context Ontology
entries.summary: The Records in Context Ontology (RiC-O) is published by the International Council on Archives (ICA) Expert Group on Archival Description (EGAD) as part of Records in Context, a conceptual model for archival description.

entries.name: Schema.org Vocabulary
entries.summary: The full schema.org vocabulary expressed as a MASP schema crate.

entries.name: Template RO-Crate Schema
entries.summary: This is a template for an RO-Crate schema.
